title: Repair native push-policy for susi-distill tags and Git 2.38-2.39 merge-tree composition
goal: Diagnose and repair Susi-native Git distillation and publication on Debian 12 LTS (`git 2.39.5`): permit create-only commit-bound `refs/tags/susi-distill/<name>` candidate snapshot tags in `push-policy` alongside `susi-snapshot/*` while preserving immutability and release-tag exact-tree qualification, and add a deterministic synthetic-base `commit-tree` + `merge-tree --write-tree` fallback in `local-distill` (`xtask::distill_compose`, covering `compose`, `orchestrate`, and `submit-main`) when `git merge-tree --merge-base=` is unavailable on Git < 2.40 while distinguishing conflict exit code 1 from fatal Git invocations.
limitations: Requires Git >= 2.38 (`git merge-tree --write-tree`); Git 2.38-2.39 uses deterministic object-store synthetic base commits (`git commit-tree`) when `--merge-base=` is absent, whereas Git >= 2.40 uses `--merge-base=` directly.
`refs/tags/susi-distill/<name>` snapshots remain immutable candidate snapshots, not qualified `vX.Y.Z` release tags.

Legacy `xtask --bin local-workflow` (outside this task's scope) has 2 host-environment failures in this cloud uVM: `cargo-deny` is not preinstalled and `statvfs` on `/tmp` exebox overlay reports 0 free blocks.
